Commentary.Commentary: We are back! The players are out there in the middle. Finn Allen and Martin Guptill are the openers for New Zealand. Safyaan Sharif will start with the ball for Scotland. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

The wicket is a decent one, it is a good one to bat on but there is a little bit of turn. New Zealand, the way they have batted on this tour, will be confident of chasing this down. Scotland on the other hand, will know they need to keep taking wickets if they are to defend this. Stay tuned for the run-chase.

New Zealand will be quite disappointed as they have left Scotland off the hook. After the start the hosts got, they did really well to get 5 quickly. Michael Bracewell was the star in that passage for New Zealand. Later on though, they were unable to stem the run flow and also struggled to take wickets. Not sure if the wicket got better or they just bowled poorly but the massive advantage they had at one stage has slipped away from them.

The start was really good for the hosts. They managed to score quickly and only lost one in the first 10. After that though, it was a struggle for quite sometime. They lost wickets in heaps and the run-scoring was also difficult. Then came Leask and counter-attacked and he did so brilliantly. He put up two important partnerships, one with Matthew Cross and the other with Mark Watt. The three in total added over 150 runs and when they were batting, 320 looked possible but wickets towards the end saw them fall short of that mark but getting to 300 from where they were is a very good achievement in itself.

That is a brilliant recovery from Scotland and they have got themselves to a really good total. They were reeling at 107 for 5 and from there, getting over 300 is a big achievement and they will feel they have given themselves a real chance in this game.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jacob Duffy takes the final wicket but Scotland will be pretty happy with this total. This is full on middle. Sole heaves it to deep mid-wicket. It goes in the air but sadly for Sole and Scotland there is not enough power behind this shot and the ball goes straight into the hands of Glenn Phillips at deep mid-wicket. Scotland are bowled out for 306!
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Jacob Duffy

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length delivery on off, Hamza Tahir pushes it of his back foot towards point and gets across for a single.
WIDE! Tries the slower ball but spears it down the leg side. Wided.

FOUR! EDGY! Scotland won't mind it at all. This is on a length and on off, Hamza Tahir tries to work it to the off side but gets a thick outside edge past the keeper diving to his right and towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Full and on off, Chris Sole drives it towards the cover fielder who dives but cannot stop the single. With that, the 300 comes up for Scotland.
Back of a length, around off. Tahir dabs it towards backward point.
Goes fuller on middle. Tahir drives it back to the bowler.
Hamza Tahir is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Lockie Ferguson bowls a good pacy short delivery angling into the body. Sharif sways away from the line of the ball and looks to upper-cut it. However, he only gets the outside edge of his blade and Dane Cleaver behind the stumps takes a good jumping catch. Nine wicket down but Scotland have managed to get to a very good total.
Commentary.Howout: c Dane Cleaver b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Great shot! This is pitched up around off, Safyaan Sharif makes room and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Full and on off, Chris Sole looks to loft but ends up slicing it to point. They cross and Sharif is back on strike.
On a length and around off, Chris Sole pushes it to backward point.

FOUR! A good over turns into an expensive one. This is on a good length and on middle, Safyaan Sharif makes room and punches it through extra covers for another boundary. He is playing a good cameo over there.
NO BALL AND FOUR! A wild full toss down the leg from Tickner, Safyaan Sharif tries to pull it away but misses and it goes past the keeper as well towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Good-length delivery on off, Safyaan Sharif knocks it back to the bowler.
Fullish delivery and on middle again. Chris Sole pushes it past the bowler and towards mid on for a run.
Full and on middle, Safyaan Sharif forces it towards long on for one.
Back of a length and on off, Safyaan Sharif stays back and swivel-pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Outside off, left alone.
Chris Sole walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Martin Guptill takes another good catch and Ferguson gets his man. This is full and outside off, Mark Watt makes room and slices it towards right of backward point where Martin Guptill is quick to dive to his right and takes it comfortably in the end. Not much celebration from the Kiwi players and Watt departs after playing a fine knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for Sharif. This is on a good length and on off, Safyaan Sharif guides it over the keeper for a boundary.

There is an appeal for caught behind but turned down. He bangs it short and on leg, angling in further, Safyaan Sharif looks to pull it but misses. The keepert appeasl for the catch but the umpire is not interested.
On a length and on off, Safyaan Sharif knocks it to covers. The dots are building now.
A bit short and on off, Mark Watt nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Well played again but cannt find the gap. He bowls it short and outside off, Safyaan Sharif cuts it hard again to point.
Pulls his length back a bit and around off, Safyaan Sharif cuts it but straight to point.
Full and on off, driven to covers.
Goes full and down the leg, Safyaan Sharif goes for the flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball goes towards the keeper who deflects it to fine leg. Two leg bye taken.
Swing and a miss! This is a bit short and outside off, Safyaan Sharif tries to cut it but misses it completely.
This is on a good length and on off, Mark Watt stays back and pushes it through covers for one.
On a length, on middle. Sharif works it to square leg and the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end as the batters looks for a single. He misses and Scotland get a second run courtesy of a run out.
Back of a length, around off. Sharif tries to push it away but misses.
Short and wide outside off. Watt cuts it to third man for a single.
On a length, angling into leg. Sharif works it to square leg for a single.
This is full on middle. Sharif drives it back to the bowler.
On a length, on off. Sharif pushes it towards the off side.
Lockie Ferguson (7-0-62-0) comes back into the attack.
Flatter and outside off. Watt pushes it to covers.
Fuller on the pads. Sharif drives it to long on for a single.
This is pitched around off and turns away. Sharif looks to push it towards the off side but gets beaten.
Shorter in length and around off. Sharif cuts it to point.
A flatter one again on middle. Watt works it towards the leg side for a single.
Quicker on middle. Sharif works it to mid-wicket for a single.
This is a crucial phase of the game, if Scotland can get close to 300 here, that will be a very good total but let's see how they go about their business in these death overs now.
On a length, around off. Sharif steers it towards third man for a single.
On a length, on off. Sharif defends it towards the off side.

A fuller delivery on middle. Sharif pushes it towards the mid on region. However, Martin Guptill at short mid-wicket moves across to his left and makes a direct under-arm throw to the bowler's end diving foward. Watt is a out of the crease but the umpire seems not interested so it's a lucky break for Scotland as New Zealand cannot review it becasue there is no DRS in this series.
Safyaan Sharif is the next batter in for Scotland.

OUT! CAUGHT! Michael Leask holes out in the deep! What a knock this has been though but he misses out on a well-deserved century here. Duffy bangs it short on on off. Leask pulls it and pulls it strongly but sadly he does not get the elevation he needed and ends up hitting it flat and straight to Martin Guptill at deep mid-wicket. He takes a fine catch and Can New Zealand now close out this innings quickly?
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Jacob Duffy

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! The Michael Leask show continues! Back of a length, on off. Leask stands still and hammers it down the ground for a boundary.
WIDE! Duffy bowls a slower delivery but ends up drifting down the leg side. Leask looks to flick it but misses.
WIDE! Goes full and wider outside off. Leask looks to get his bat on it but misses.
Back of a length, around off. Watt punches it to covers for a single.
Short and outside off. Watt cuts it to sweeper cover for a single. 12 from the over and Scotland are moving towards a healthy score now.
FOUR! Brilliantly played! On off. Watt reverse-sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.

FOUR! Finds the edge but it runs away towards the fence! Watt skips down the track and Santner bowls it a bit short and outside off. Watt throws his bat at it. He gets a thick outside edge and the ball runs away towards the third man fence.
Short and outside off. Leask slaps it towards deep extra-cover for a single.
Shorter in length, on off. Watt works it through square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Leask sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over, 19 from it! On a length, on leg. Watt tucks it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Shorter in length, on off. Leask heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Another one over the fence! This is in the slot, on off. Leask tonks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
SIX! Michael Leask is putting on a show here! On a length, on middle. Leask just swipes it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
A fuller delivery, drifting on the pads. Watt looks to flick it but misses. A leg bye taken as the ball deflects towards fine leg.
A full delivery on off. Leask drills it to long on for a single.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this innings. Also, Jacob Duffy is back on.

FOUR! Back to back boundaries for Watt. Tickner bowls a low full toss on off, Mark Watt opens the face of his bat and drives it to right of extra cover. The fileder at sweeper gives chase but cannot stop it from going to the boundary. A huge over for Scotland as they get 14 runs of it.
FOUR! Up and over! This is pitched up on off, Mark Watt comes down the track and smashes it over mid off for a boundary,
Full toss and on off, but once again the batter fails to put it away.
Full and on leg, angling in, Michael Leask makes room and clips it through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Well bowled but a boundary. This is in the blockhole, on middle, Michael Leask goes for the big shot but gets an inside edge past the stumps. The ball races away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Goes fuler on off. Watt drills it to long on for a single.
Another full toss and on middle, Michael Leask drives it towards long on for a brace. Mitchell got away with a lot of losse deliveries in this over.
Length delivery on off, Mark Watt works it through covers for one.
Slower length delivery, on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full toss again, outside off, Michael Leask forces it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Takes the pace off and bowls it on a length, on off, Michael Leask guides it to point.
Full toss and on middle, Michael Leask drills it towards mid off. It was tere to be hit.
Good length and on off, Watt knocks it to covers.
Goes fuller and outside off, Mark Watt drives it towards point where the fielder does well to stop it diving to his right.
Short again and on leg, Michael Leask heaves it over mid-wicket but only for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! He bangs this short on middle and leg, Michael Leask gets on top of it and pulls it past the diving short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
On a length and on off, Michael Leask makes room and punches it towards mid off.
Full and outside off, Mark Watt goes for the drive but gets a thick outside edge towards third man. They cross.
Slower one, on a length and on off, Michael Leask only manages to push it back to the bowler. A wicket and two runs from the over.
Good length and around off, Mark Watt flicks it through square leg for one. With that, the 200 comes up for Scotland.
Back of a length and on off, Watt knocks it down the pitch.
On a length and outside off, Mark Watt leaves it alone.
Mark Watt walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Daryl Mitchell has done it as he breaks this big partnership. He bowls it slightly slower, short and on off, Matthew Cross tries to guide towards third man but only manages an edge to the keeper. Dane Cleaver moves to his right and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dane Cleaver b Daryl Mitchell

Commentary.Commentary: Mitchell starts with a length delivery and on middle, Michael Leask pulls it hard towards deep square leg for one. He will be dissappointed not to put that away.
Change of bat now for Michael Leask!
Short and on leg, Michael Leask forces it towards long on for a single. It looks like he has broken his bat with that shot.

FOUR! Fifty for Michael Leask and what a way to bring it up as well. This is short and outside off, Michael Leask stands tall and punches it through extra covers for a boundary. This has been a great counter-attacking knock by him and that too under pressure.
Goes full and down the leg, Matthew Cross tries to flick it but misses and the ball goes of his pads towards the keeper who cannaot collect it properly. They run a leg bye.
A bit short and on middle and leg, Michael Leask slaps it down to long on for a run.
Pulls his length back a bit and outside off, Matthew Cross opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for one.
Tickner starts with a full delivery around off, Michael Leask drives it through cover-point for a single.
Blair Tickner is back into the attack now!

DRINKS! This has been a good counter-attacking stand for Scotland. They were in a spot of bother and badly needed a partnership and these two have now taken them to comparitively safer shores. New Zealand have been bit short today and they need to break this partnership now to restrict Scotland to a below-par total here.
On a length, on off. Leask pulls it wide of mid on for a single.

FOUR! In the air...but just away from the fielder and it runs away towards the fence. Back of a length, on off. Leask clears his front leg and swings across the line. He gets a top edge towards the deep mid-wicket region and the fielder at mid-wicket runs back and dives to catch it. However, he fails to reach it and it is a boundary in the end.
FOUR! This has been a good counter-attacking partnership for Scotland! This is short, around off. Leask slams it towards the long on fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Cross steers it towards third man for a single.
On a length, on off. Cross defends it towards the off side.

FOUR! Fifty for Matthew Cross! Fantastic knock under pressure. He has been brutal against anything short and Ferguson bowls it short, on off again. Cross pulls it to backward square leg fence for a boundary.
On the shorter side, on off. Leask plays it back to the bowler.
SIX! Nice use of the feet! Tossed up delivery on middle. Leask dances down the track and slams it over wide long on for a maximum.
On middle and Cross sweeps it firmly to deep square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Leask sweeps it past short fine leg for a single.
Goes fuller, on off. Cross makes a bit of room and goes inside-out towards sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter and around off. Cross cuts it to point.
Back of a length, on leg. Cross looks to work it away but misses. The ball deflects off his pads towards the leg side and the batters take a leg bye.
FOUR! Cross takes full advantage of the Free Hit! It is short on off. Cross clears his front leg again and hammers it towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
NO BALL! A full toss on middle. Leask lofts it towards the long on region and comes back for the second run. The umpire calls it a wide and we have a Free Hit coming up.
Back of a length, on off. Leask looks to pull it but gets the bottom of his blade as the ball rolls away from the turf.
On a length, on off. Leask clears his front leg and looks to heave it towards the leg side. He gets the inside edge that goes past the stumps towards fine leg. Two runs taken.
Back of a length, around off. Cross guides it to third man for a single.
Goes fuller on middle and leg. Cross looks to flick it but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
The umpires in the middle have decided to change the ball.
Keeps his length short and fires this one quicker on middle. Cross mistimes his pull to mid-wicket for a single.
Fraction short and around off again. Leask cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Cross sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Beaten! This is tad fuller and around off. Cross looks to drive it away but misses.
A flatter one around off again and Cross pushes it right of point this time.
This is pitched around off. It is quicker and Cross chops it to point.

SIX! A boundary to start and a boundary to end the over. Ferguson continues bowling short, this is on middle, Michael Leask waits for it and smokes it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 12 runs from the over then.
Bangs in a short ball again, Matthew Cross looks to pull it but gets a top edge towards fine leg. They cross.
Short and on off, this is knocked to backward point.

Another tough chance. Ferguson lands it on a length and onto the body of the batter, Michael Leask tries to pull it over the short third man but cannot get on top of the bounce. The ball falls just short of the fielder.
Back of a length delivery on off, Michael Leask goes to cut it but only manages to bunt the ball onto the ground.
FOUR! Leask welcomes Ferguson to his second spell with a boundary. This is on a good length and outside off, Michael Leask makes room and crunches it through extra covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Another poor delivery and gives away 14 in the over! Bowls another short delivery on middle. Cross stays back and pulls it in front of square this time for a boundary.
FOUR! Short and punished! A half-tracker on middle. Cross rocks back and pulls it to the square leg fence for a boundary.
Goes fuller on middle. Leask sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Cross works it right of mid on for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Cross blocks it out.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Shorter in length and around off. Cross goes deep in his crease and just guides it through backward point for a boundary.

Dropped! A tough chance but it goes begging. This is shorter in length and on off, Michael Leask tries to cut it but slices it in the air towards short third man. The fileder there dives forward but cannot not grab it.
Shorter in length and around off, Michael Leask cuts it but straight to point.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is full and outside off, Leask slogs it towards the long on fence for a boundary.
Short again and on middle, Leask tucks it to mid-wicket.
A bit short and off, Leask cuts it to the left of cover.
Tossed up on off, Leask blocks it to covers.
Short and on off, pushed to covers for one.
Flatter and quicker on off, Matthew Cross cuts it to the left of sweeper cover for one.

In the air...but safe! This is pitched around off and Cross looks to slog it towards the leg side. The ball goes off the top edge and falls away from Mark Chapman who runs back from mid-wicket to catch it. Two taken.
Good bowling by Santner. This is pushed through quicker and on middle, Matthew Cross looks to defend but misses and gets hit on his front pad.
Floated on off, Michael Leask pushes it to covers for a quick single.

Slightly shorter and on off, Cross guides to point and calls for the single. His partner responds to it and they complete the run. But, if the throw would have been better Leask was nowhere near the crease.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over then. This is tossed up full and on off, Michael Leask lofts it towards the long off fence for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Matthew Cross stays back and pushes it towards covers for another single.
On off, kept out.
A bit short and on off, Michael Leask punches it through covers for one.
Floated on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and on middle, Cross punches it past the bowler for a single.
Quicker and on off, Cross dabs it to the square on off side for one.
Loopy delivery on middle, Matthew Cross looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge to the off side.
Flatter and full on middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
On off, kept out.
A huge shout for LBW but turned down. This is tossed up on middle, angling in, Michael Leask goes for the block but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the finger stays down.
Floated full and on middle, Matthew Cross goes down and sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Short and outside off. Leask looks to cut it but misses. Brilliant over, just one run and a wicket in it.
On the shorter side and outside off. Leask punches it to covers.
Fires it on off and flatter. Michael Leask plays it back to the bowler.
Michael Leask comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Michael Bracewell gets his third wicket! Chris Greaves departs while trying to play his favourite shot. Michael Bracewell pitches it on off and gets good turn and boune into the batter. Chris Greaves goes a bit across and looks to sweep it. However, the ball catches the outside edge of his blade and goes towards short fine leg. Blair Tickner there moves back a bit and takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Blair Tickner b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches it on off. Cross sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Pushed quicker on off. Cross blocks it out.
Tossed up, outside off. Cross drives it to wide long off for a single.
Goes tad shorter on off. Chris Greaves goes across and works it to square leg for a single.
On the shorter side and turn away from the batter again. Chris Greaves goes back and blocks it out.
An arm ball on middle. Chris Greaves plays it back to the bowler.
A fuller delivery on off. Pushed towards the off side.
Sharp turn there! This is pitched outside off and it turns further away as the ball beats the outside edge of Chris Greaves's blade as he gets across and looks to defend.
FOUR! This time he finds the gap! Short and outside off. Cross rocks back and cuts it firmly past point for a boundary. 9 from the over!
Short and wide outside off. Cross cuts it to point.
Dropped!  Pitching it on middle. Chris Greaves goes for the sweep shot this time and gets a bit of top edge. The ball goes towards short fine leg and the fielder there drops it. A single taken.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is slower through the air, around off. Chris Greaves gets low and reverse-sweeps it fine towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Fraction shorter on middle. Chris Greaves works it to square leg.
A flatter delivery on middle. Chris Greaves blocks it out.
Goes fuller on middle. Cross sweeps it to fine leg and comes back for the second run as the fielder in the deep cuts it off.
Pushed quicker and outside off. Cross tries to cut but misses.
Shorter and around off. Cross punches it towards the off side.
Cross skips down the track and Santner very cleverly pulls his length back a bit, on off. Cross looks to work it towards the leg side but gets hit high on the pads.
A flatter one on off. This time Cross defends it off the middle of his blade.
Slower through the air, around off. Cross tries to defend but gets a thick outside edge to point.
Another dot ball and this is a wicket-maiden from Michael Bracewell! Excellent stuff! Goes fuller on middle. Chris Greaves works it right of mid off.
Again that delivery that pitches on off and turns in. Chris Greaves only manages to work it towards the leg side.
Turning into middle. Chris Greaves defends it off the front foot towards the leg side.
Chris Greaves is the next batter in for Scotland. Can he be the man to take them out of trouble? We will find out.

OUT! CAUGHT! Richie Berrington departs now and Scotland lose their fourth! Michael Bracewell bowls it on off and it is a bit quicker. Tad shorter in length too and Richie Berrington looks to reverse-sweep it. He, however, only manages to get a top edge of his blade and gives away an easy catch to Mark Chapman at short third man. Scotland are losing their way a bit in these middle overs, they need a partnership here.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Chapman b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: A flatter delivery on middle. Richie Berrington works it towards the leg side.
Tad shorter and outside off. Richie Berrington guides it towards backward point.
This is full and outside off. Richie Berrington drives it to covers for another single.
Tossed up, outside off. Cross drives it to long off for a single.
On middle and quicker. Cross works it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! This time a misfield by Glenn Phillips allows a boundary! Mitchell Santner bowls it on middle. Cross sweeps it firmly to deep backward square leg. Glenn Phillips running to his right, gets to the ball but fails to collect it as the ball cross the fence.
Goes fuller on the pads. Cross sweeps it to short fine leg.
Starts off with a flatter one on middle. Tad shorter in length and Cross works it to mid-wicket.
Mitchell Santner, the skipper comes into the attack now.
FOUR! That is a really good shot and a good end to the over for the batting side! This is tossed up outside off, it is swept wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Tossed up on off, blocked.
FOUR! Up and over! Welcome boundary! Shorter and outside off, this is cut over point and the ball races away to the fence.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Wided.
Angled into the pads, Richie Berrington looks to flick, this goes off a soft leading edge to point.
Back of a length and on off, this is guided to point.
Angled into the pads, Cross works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Just the one! Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Even the singles are tough to come by now! On off, this is pushed to cover.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, defended.

Drinks! Scotland started very well with Kyle Coetzer and Michael Jones scoring runs at a good rate. But once Coetzer fell, New Zealand got the grip of the game and picked up two more wickets. Also, Matthew Cross comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TIMBER! That was a gem of a delivery! A wicket an offie would enjoy! Perfect pace and length from Michael Bracewell. He slows it up, lands it outside off and gets it to turn back in. Michael Jones looks to defend but the ball sneaks between the gap of bat and pad and hits the stumps. Scotland in trouble now.
Shorter and on off, this is guided to point.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket. The series of dot balls continues.
Tossed up on off, blocked.
Another good over from Tickner! On a good length and on middle, this one takes off after landing. Richie Berrington looks to defend but this hits the splice and rolls on the off side.
Tidy stuff from Blair! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Extra bounce! On the shorter side, Richie Berrington slashes at it but misses.
Angled into middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Back of a length delivery and on off, defended.
Tip and run! On off, Michael Jones plays it towards point and gets to the other end.
BEATEN! Outside off, this goes on with the arm. Richie Berrington plays for the turn but is beaten.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Jones now gets to the other end but pushing this down to long on.
Another single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Around off, this is hit down to long on with the turn for one.
Shorter again and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is guided to point.
Another one on a length and outside off, left alone.
That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Richie Berrington is beaten as he tries to defend.
Richie Berrington is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Blair Tickner gets the wicket he deserves. He has been really good so far, not the best of deliveries he has bowled till now but he will not care. Sharp catch from Guptill. Shorter and outside off, this is cut firmly but straight to Martin Guptill who takes it nicely.
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: A slower one, well outside off, Jones slashes but misses. It lands in front of the keeper who does not take it cleanly and a bye is taken.
Shorter and outside off, Jones chops it to covers.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On middle, this one turns back in sharply. Defended.
Two! On the shorter side and outside off, this is cut towards point. The fielder misfields and two is taken.
Fires this one outside off, left alone.
Shorter and outside off, this is played through point for a couple.
On off, defended.
Three in a row! A lovely over from Blair Tickner! Another one on a length and outside off, Calum MacLeod is beaten yet again as he tries to block.
BEATEN AGAIN! Length again and on off, Calum MacLeod yet again looks to defend but does not lay bat on ball.
BEATEN! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Calum MacLeod is beaten as he tries to defend.
Shortish again, Jones rides on top of the bounce and guides it down to third man for one.
That is a beauty! Length and on off, this one lands and zips through. Jones looks to defend but is beaten.
Was that a chance? On a length and around off, this is pushed back to the left of the bowler. He dives and looks to take it low but it does not stick. Tough chance.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, Calum MacLeod plays the reverse sweep, it goes fine on the off side for two.
On off, this is eased down to long off for a single. Needs to pitch it up.
Two more! On the shorter side, this is pushed wide of the sweeper cover fielder for two.
Shortish again, this is yet again pushed through covers for one more.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Turn for Michael Bracewell! Shorter and outside off, this one turns back in. Jones pushes it to covers.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, it time for some spin as Michael Bracewell is brought into the attack.
Goes fuller and straight, Calum MacLeod moves across and clips it to mid-wicket. 9 runs from the over.
Better from Tickner. This is on a good length and on middle, Calum MacLeod pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Very poor from Tickner. He gives width again on off, Calum MacLeod gets into position early and smashes it over covers and picks up a boundary.
Back of length, on off, Calum MacLeod knocks it straight to point.
A bit short again and on off, Michael Jones cuts it from his back foot through covers for a single.
FOUR! Tickner starts with a loose delivery and is rightly punished. This is short and wide outside off, Michael Jones stays back and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Blair Tickner is into the attack.
Slower one from Duffy, on a length, on middle, Calum MacLeod negotiates it well. A wicket and just a run from the over then.
Goes a bit fuller and on middle, Calum MacLeod moves across and nudges it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, on off, Calum MacLeod pushes it towards covers.
Good length and on off, Calum MacLeod leaves it alone.
Calum MacLeod walks out at number 3!

OUT! CAUGHT! Jacob Duffy gets the breakthrough and sends Coetzer back in the hut. He bowls this a bit short and on middle, Kyle Coetzer looks to pull it but gets cramped and cannot get hold of it. The ball goes in the air and straight into the hands of Blair Tickner who is stationed at mid on.
Commentary.Howout: c Blair Tickner b Jacob Duffy

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on middle, angling in, Michael Jones looks to drive it the off side but gets an inside edge towards square leg. They cross.
On a length and on off, Kyle Coetzer blocks it out.
Pitched up again and on off, Kyle Coetzer drills it wide of mid off.
A low full toss on off, Michael Jones drives it towards mid off for one.
Full and on leg, angling in, Kyle Coetzer flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
BEATEN! This is full and on off, Kyle Coetzer goes for the drive but gets beaten on the outside edge again. He seems to be rushing into his shots a bit.
Starts with a length delivery around off, Michael Jones taps it with soft hands to the off side for a quick single.
Full and outside off, Kyle Coetzer drives it to mid off.
Duffy bowls it on a length and on middle, shaping in, Kyle Coetzer tries to block it but gets hit on his pads. There is a slight shout for LBW but the finger stays down.
Length and on off, Michael Jones knocks it to the off side and picks up a single.
Back of a length and on off, Kyle Coetzer punches of his back foot through covers for one.
Swing and a miss! This is a good-length delivery on off, holds its line, Kyle Coetzer tries to push at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length and on off, kept out.
FOUR! Punished! Ferguson bangs it short and on middle and leg, Michael Jones pulls it wide of the deep square leg for the second boundary of the over.
BEATEN! This is on a length and on off, shaping in, Michael Jones goes for the drive but the ball goes just past the inside edge.
FOUR! Cracking shot! This is full again and outside off, Michael Jones stands there and smashes it away towards the deep backward point fence for a boundary.
Goes full and outside off, Michael Jones tries to poke at it from his crease but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and on off, angling in, Michael Jones blocks it to the off side.
Length and on off, Jones blocks it out.
A fullish delivery, around off. Kyle Coetzer drives it to covers.

Appeal for an LBW but turned down! Just short of good length and coming in with the angle on middle and leg. Kyle Coetzer looks to clip it away but misses. The ball hits him high on the pads and it is probably going over the stumps.
On a length, angling into middle. Jones works it wide of square leg for a single.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Jones ducks under it.
Back of a length, around off. Jones rides the bounce and steers it behind square on the off side.
On a length, around off. It seams away after pitching and beats the outside edge of the batter's blade as he looks to drive it.
On a length and outside off. Jones leaves it alone.
A good-length delivery and outside off. Kyle Coetzer leaves it alone.
FOUR! Another lovely shot! Goes fuller and outside off. Kyle Coetzer drives it through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Goes fuller an down the leg side. Kyle Coetzer leaves it alone.
FOUR! Kyle Coetzer is looking in good touch here! Short and angling into the body. Kyle Coetzer pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Kyle Coetzer blocks it out.
Pulls his length back slightly, around off. Kyle Coetzer drives it to covers.
FOUR! Overpitched and Kyle Coetzer takes full advantage of it. This is on the pads and Kyle Coetzer connects the flick shot this time. He caresses it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
WIDE! Lockie Ferguson drifts down the leg side and Kyle Coetzer looks to flick it but misses.
Serves it on a length again, around off. Jones tries to work it towards the leg side but gets a bit of leading edge towards the off side.
On a length, around off. Kyle Coetzer guides it to third man for a single.
Bit on the shorter side again, around off. Kyle Coetzer defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! Nice placement! Back of a length, around off. Kyle Coetzer rides the bounce and punches it past the diving fielder at point for a boundary.
Goes fuller and on middle. Kyle Coetzer flicks it wide of mid on.
Short and wide outside off. Kyle Coetzer looks to cut it but misses.
Lovely delivery to the end the over! In that channel, outside off. Jones just pushes his blade towards it. The ball seams away and beats the outside edge of his blade.
WIDE! Lockie Ferguson bowls it on a good length and tries to keep it away from the batter. Jones leaves it. However, the umpire thinks that it is too wide outside off and gives it a wide.
Back of a length, on off. Jones goes back and blocks it out.
Serves on a good length and outside off. Jones makes a careful leave again.
Goes bit straighter and fuller on off. Jones drives it back to the bowler.
A good-length delivery and outside off. Jones leaves it alone.
Lands on a length, on off. Jones defends it off the front foot.
WIDE! Just like Jacob Duffy, Lockie Ferguson also starts off with a wide. This is full and down the leg side. Jones looks to flick it but misses.
Lockie Ferguson is ready to share the new ball from the other end.
Good start for Scotland! 9 from the first over! Back of a length, around off. Kyle Coetzer punches it nicely through covers for a couple.
Back of a length, on off. Jones looks to work it towards the leg side. However, he gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
FOUR! Michael Jones is off the mark in style! Short and this time some width on offer. Jones gets on the top of the bounce and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Jones with a solid block off the back foot.
Duffy continues to keep it short, on middle. Jones rides the bounce and defends it towards the leg side.
On the shorter side again, angling into the body. Kyle Coetzer pulls it to deep square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
WIDE! Duffy starts off with a short delivery, it is angling down the leg side. Kyle Coetzer ducks under it.

The conditions are overcast and we might just see New Zealand pacers getting some good swing with the new ball. Scotland batters need to apply themselves here especially with the new ball and let's hope they give something to cheer for their home crowd. The players now walk out to the middle. Kyle Coetzer and Michael Jones are the openers for Scotland. Jacob Duffy will start with the ball for New Zealand. Here we go...

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Finn Allen, Dane Cleaver (WK), Mark Chapman, Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner (C), Lockie Ferguson, Jacob Duffy, Blair Tickner.
Scotland (Playing XI) - Kyle Coetzer, Michael Jones, Calum MacLeod, Richie Berrington (C), Matthew Cross (WK), Chris Greaves, Michael Leask, Mark Watt, Safyaan Sharif, Chris Sole, Hamza Tahir.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Scotland. They have elected to BAT first.
The news coming out from the middle is that the start of the game will be delayed by 15 minutes. It will start at 3.45 pm IST (10.15 am GMT). We shall be ready for the toss soon. Stay tuned.
